reply.text: I can't tell you that one is safe or how much to take. Pre-workouts are mostly stimulant blends, so doubling up means doubling the caffeine and everything else in them, and that is a question for a doctor or a dietitian, who can look at your own health and what you take. If you're not sure what a product leans on, read the label and ask them about the combination. On the training side, I'm happy to help you get more out of a session without stacking products, whether that's timing, sleep, or what you eat beforehand.
